info.name: AutoLead API
info.description:
AutoLead backend — used-car brokerage API.

**Auth:** email + password. JWT is identity only; live roles come from `user_roles` on each request.

**Staff routes** require Bearer + Admin role. **Owner routes** require Bearer + Admin or Salesperson (deactivate is Admin-only). **Catalog, Vehicles, Leads, Notifications, Dashboard, Showrooms** accept Admin or Salesperson; lead assignment, vehicle status changes, and media/document deletes are Admin-only. A salesperson only sees leads assigned to them.

Error envelope: `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string } }`
Pagination: `limit` default 20 max 100; `offset` default 0; page `{ items, total, limit, offset }`.

Flow: Login → create owner → pick catalog variant → create vehicle → create lead → associate vehicle → assign lead → schedule follow-up → change status → inbox.

request.description: GET /health — 200 `{ status, timestamp }`.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Email + password. Login and Refresh are public. Me requires Bearer.

request.description: POST /auth/login — 200 `{ accessToken, refreshToken }`. Invalid credentials → 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS.
POST /auth/refresh — 200 rotated `{ accessToken, refreshToken }`.

Returns the authenticated user's profile and live roles.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**200** — Profile returned successfully.

**401** — Missing or invalid token (`AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`).

**404** — Token valid but user record no longer exists (`NOT_FOUND`).

**503** — Database unavailable (`DB_UNAVAILABLE`). Previously caused by an ambiguous PostgREST FK embed on `user_roles → users`; fixed by disambiguating with `users!user_id!inner(deleted_at)`.

response.name: 503 DB Unavailable

request.description:
POST /auth/logout — 204. Ends this session (`local`, default) or every session (`global`). Their refresh tokens stop working. Clears the stored tokens.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

POST /auth/change-password — 204. Other sessions end; this one stays signed in.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**422** `INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD`, `PASSWORD_UNCHANGED`, `WEAK_PASSWORD`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` (new password under 8 characters).
POST /auth/forgot-password — 202 `{ message }`, the same answer whether or not the account exists. Emails a 6-digit code valid for 15 minutes.

POST /auth/reset-password — 204. Every session ends; sign in again with the new password.

**422** `INVALID_RESET_CODE` (wrong or expired code), `WEAK_PASSWORD`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

item.name: Users
item.description: Admin-only staff CRUD. Roles: admin | salesperson. JWT must belong to an admin in user_roles.

request.description: POST /users — 201. Provisions Auth user (email + password) + profile + staff roles.
GET /users — paginated. Optional `role=admin` or `role=salesperson`.
GET /users/:id — 200 staff member or 404.
PATCH /users/:id — name, phone, email, showroomId. Email is required.
PUT /users/:id/roles — replace set, min 1. Cannot drop the last admin.
DELETE /users/:id — 204 soft-deactivate. Cannot deactivate self or last admin.

item.name: Owners
item.description: Staff owner CRUD. Admin or Salesperson. Deactivate is Admin-only. Phone is the unique live key.

request.description: POST /owners — 201. Duplicate live phone → 409 CONFLICT.

query.description: Partial match on name, phone or city

request.description: GET /owners — paginated. Optional `city` and `phone` filters. Optional search: partial match on name, phone or city.
GET /owners/:id — 200 owner or 404.
PATCH /owners/:id — profile fields. Duplicate live phone → 409.
DELETE /owners/:id — 204 soft-deactivate. Admin only.
GET /catalog/makes — paginated makes. Admin or Salesperson.
GET /catalog/makes/:makeId/models — Admin.
GET /catalog/models/:modelId/variants — includes factory fuel, transmission, ex-showroom price.
POST /vehicles — Admin or Salesperson. `showroomId` is optional: it defaults to your home showroom, and only admins may name another. Duplicate live registration → 409.

GET /vehicles — filters: status, ownerId, showroomId, registration. Each item carries `frontImageUrl` / `frontImageUrlExpiresAt` (signed URL of the lowest-sortOrder `front` photo, ~10 min; both null when there is none) for list thumbnails. Optional: search, makeId, modelId, variantId, yearMin/yearMax, kmMin/kmMax, fuelType and transmission (comma-separated). Items carry linkedLeadCount.
- `priceMin` / `priceMax` (whole rupees, optional): inclusive `listedPrice` range; cars without a listed price drop out; a min above its max is `422`.
GET /vehicles/:id — catalog names and `frontImageUrl` / `frontImageUrlExpiresAt` included.
PATCH /vehicles/:id — second-hand details only.

POST /vehicles/:id/status (Admin) — 200 `{ status, unlinkedLeadCount }`. Only `dropped` and `open` (re-list) are accepted; `linked` / `sold` follow the vehicle's leads → 422 VEHICLE_STATUS_SYSTEM_MANAGED. Graph: open ⇄ linked (auto), linked → sold (auto, lead converts), open/linked → dropped, dropped → open. Dropping a vehicle with active leads → 422 VEHICLE_HAS_LINKED_LEADS with `error.details.linkedLeadCount`; resend with `confirmUnlinkLeads: true` to unlink those leads and drop it.
GET /vehicles/:id/status-history — newest first. Each item has `changedBy` (user id) and `changedByName` (that user's full name).
POST /vehicles/:id/media/uploads — then PUT bytes to uploadUrl.
POST /vehicles/:id/media — object must already exist in storage.
GET /vehicles/:id/media — includes short-lived signed read URLs.
DELETE /vehicles/:id/media/:mediaId (Admin) — 204.
POST /vehicles/:id/documents/uploads — then PUT bytes to uploadUrl.
POST /vehicles/:id/documents — object must already exist in storage. Optional `fileName` (display name; folder part dropped, 1–255 chars) is stored and returned as `fileName`.
GET /vehicles/:id/documents — signed read URLs only; always sensitive. `fileName` is the uploader's original name, or null for older uploads (fall back to docType).
DELETE /vehicles/:id/documents/:documentId (Admin) — 204.

request.description: POST /leads — walk-in contact by phone. Admin or Salesperson; a salesperson's lead is assigned to them. `showroomId` is optional. Optional catalog preference `preferredMakeId` / `preferredModelId` / `preferredVariantId` (send only the narrowest; parents are filled in; mismatched parents → 422 PREFERRED_CATALOG_MISMATCH; unknown id → 404). Optional preference profile (empty = any): `preferredColours[]` (free text), `preferredFuelTypes[]` (petrol|diesel|cng|electric|hybrid), `preferredTransmissions[]` (manual|automatic|amt|cvt|dct), `preferredBodyTypes[]` (hatchback|sedan|suv|muv|mpv|crossover|coupe|convertible|sports|pick-up), `preferredYearMin` / `preferredYearMax`, `preferredKmMax`, `preferredMaxOwners`; `budget` is the price ceiling. Invalid values → 422 VALIDATION_ERROR.

GET /leads — filters (all optional, AND-combined): status, vehicleId, assignedTo (admin only), preferredMakeId, preferredModelId, preferredVariantId, search (contact name/phone, partial), budgetMin, budgetMax, source (comma-separated), hasVehicle (true|false), purchaseTimeline, financeRequired (true|false), createdFrom (inclusive), createdTo (exclusive). A salesperson only sees leads assigned to them. Items include `assignedToName`, `linkedVehicle` ({ id, makeName, modelName, variantName, year, registrationNumber } or null) and the preferred catalog ids + names.
- `linkedMakeId` / `linkedModelId` / `linkedVariantId` (uuid, optional, AND-combined): the catalog of the car linked to the lead; leads with no car or another car drop out.

**Story:** On a car's detail screen, staff see how well each linked lead's preference fits the car, plus open leads worth calling about it.

GET /leads/vehicle-matches/:vehicleId — Admin or Salesperson (a salesperson only gets leads assigned to them).

- `minScore` (optional int 0–100, default 60): lowest score for a suggestion.
- `limit` (optional int 1–50, default 10): most suggestions.

200 `{ vehicle, linked, suggested, truncated }`:
- `vehicle`: the car's matchable attributes (make/model/variant ids + names, year, kmDriven, colour, fuelType, transmission, bodyTypes, numPreviousOwners, listedPrice or null).
- `linked`: every lead linked to the car, best match first; each is the lead object plus `match: { score, evaluatedCriteria, breakdown[] } | null` (null = no preference).
- `suggested`: open (`new` / `not_now` / `vehicle_unavailable`), unlinked leads in the car's showroom scoring ≥ minScore on ≥ 2 criteria.
- `truncated`: only the newest 1000 open leads were scored.
- breakdown item: `criterion` (catalog|budget|year|km|fuelType|transmission|bodyType|previousOwners|colour), `weight`, `earned`, `outcome` (match|partial|miss|unknown).

Errors: 404 unknown car; 422 VALIDATION_ERROR on bad query; 403 non-staff.

**Story:** On a lead's detail screen, staff see how well the linked car fits the buyer, plus cars in stock worth showing them.

GET /leads/:id/vehicle-matches — Admin or Salesperson (a salesperson only for leads assigned to them; others → 404).

- `minScore` (optional int 0–100, default 60): lowest score for a suggestion.
- `limit` (optional int 1–50, default 10): most suggestions.

200 `{ linked, suggested, truncated }`:
- `linked`: `{ vehicle, match }` for the car linked to the lead, or null. `match` is null when the lead has no preference.
- `suggested`: `{ vehicle, match }[]` — live cars in the lead's showroom with status `open` or `linked` (not the lead's own car), scoring ≥ minScore on ≥ 2 criteria, best first. Empty when the lead has no preference.
- `truncated`: only the newest 1000 cars were scored.
- `vehicle` and `match` have the same shape as in Vehicle Lead Matches.

Errors: 404 unknown lead; 422 VALIDATION_ERROR on bad query; 403 non-staff.
GET /leads/:id — includes next follow-up, `linkedVehicle` summary, and preferred catalog ids + names.

PATCH /leads/:id (Admin, or the assigned Salesperson) — 200 lead. Full replace of fullName, phone, email, source, budget, purchaseTimeline, financeRequired, currentVehicle, tradeInRequired, notes (omitted optional fields are cleared). A new phone moves the lead to that phone's contact. Closed lead → 422 LEAD_CLOSED. Embeds (linkedVehicle, names) are null in the response; GET for them.

request.description: PUT /leads/:id/assignment (Admin) — 200 `{ id, assignedTo }`. assignedTo must be an active admin or salesperson, or null to unassign. Notifies the assignee (`lead_assigned`). Closed lead → 422 LEAD_CLOSED.

PUT /leads/:id/preference (Admin, or the assigned Salesperson) — 200 with the whole preference (`preferredMakeId` … `preferredMaxOwners`). Full replace: every field you omit is cleared, so send the whole form; an empty body clears it. Catalog: send only the narrowest id and the server fills in its parents (mismatch → 422 PREFERRED_CATALOG_MISMATCH; unknown/deleted id → 404). Profile fields: `preferredColours[]`, `preferredFuelTypes[]` (petrol|diesel|cng|electric|hybrid), `preferredTransmissions[]` (manual|automatic|amt|cvt|dct), `preferredBodyTypes[]` (hatchback|sedan|suv|muv|mpv|crossover|coupe|convertible|sports|pick-up), `preferredYearMin`/`preferredYearMax` (1950–2100, min ≤ max), `preferredKmMax` (≥ 0), `preferredMaxOwners` (≥ 0); invalid → 422 VALIDATION_ERROR. Budget (the price ceiling) is edited with PATCH /leads/:id. Closed lead → 422 LEAD_CLOSED.
PATCH /leads/:id/vehicle — attach a live vehicle.

DELETE /leads/:id/vehicle (Admin, or the assigned Salesperson) — 200 `{ vehicleId: null }`. Clears the link; the vehicle goes back to open when no other active lead holds it. Closed lead → 422 LEAD_CLOSED; booking_confirmed → 422 LEAD_REQUIRES_VEHICLE.
POST /leads/:id/follow-ups — assigned to the lead's assignee (or you if unassigned), who gets the due notification.

POST /leads/:id/status — 200 `{ status, vehicleSold }`. new → not_now | booking_confirmed | lost; not_now → new | booking_confirmed | lost; booking_confirmed → converted | lost; vehicle_unavailable → new | not_now | booking_confirmed | lost. booking_confirmed/converted need a vehicle (422 LEAD_REQUIRES_VEHICLE); vehicle_unavailable is system-only. Invalid transition → 422.
GET /leads/:id/status-history — 200 page, newest first, of { id, leadId, fromStatus, toStatus, changedBy, changedByName, notes, changedAt }. Same visibility as GET /leads/:id.

POST /leads/:id/status from booking_confirmed — sells the lead's vehicle to this lead (vehicle `soldLeadId`) and moves every other active lead on that vehicle to vehicle_unavailable (vehicle unlinked). Safe to repeat if it fails part-way.

GET /notifications — the caller's inbox (Admin or Salesperson): `lead_assigned` right away, `follow_up_due` at the scheduled time. Optional isRead=true|false. Response adds unreadCount (unread due items, whatever the filter); items carry leadId.
PATCH /notifications/:id/read — 204. Own notifications only.

query.description: Optional showroom UUID; omit for all showrooms

request.description: GET /dashboard — Admin or Salesperson. Period-to-date KPIs with `previous` (same elapsed span of the prior period), attention lists (overdue follow-ups, active leads without a follow-up, aged stock > 45 days), today's follow-ups, pipeline and inventory. Lists hold up to 5 rows plus `total`. Invalid `period` → 422. See docs/api.md#dashboard--admin-or-salesperson. Admin: scope 'all'. Salesperson: scope 'mine' (own leads), with kpis.inStock, attention.agedStock and inventory null.

response.name: 200 Dashboard

query.description: Optional showroom UUID; omit for all showrooms

request.description: GET /showrooms (Admin or Salesperson) — 200 page of { id, name, city }, active showrooms by name.

item.name: Finance
item.description: Admin-only, encrypted finance (ADR-0014/0015). Run Vault › Setup → Confirm → Unlock first; the scripts carry keys, the session token and created ids in collection variables.

request.description:
**Story:** When the admin opens Finance, the app asks which screen to show: set up, confirm the recovery key, enter the finance key, or the finance screens.

GET /finance/vault — vault state and whether this request carries a valid session.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only.

- Header `X-Finance-Session` (optional): the token from Unlock. Checking it does **not** extend the session.
- `200` `{ initialized, confirmed, unlocked, expiresAt }`:
  - `initialized` — a vault exists (pending or confirmed)
  - `confirmed` — the recovery key was confirmed; finance can be unlocked
  - `unlocked` — the header holds a live session
  - `expiresAt` — ISO time the session locks if left idle, or null

- Every finance response sends `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- Salespeople get `403 FORBIDDEN`. See docs/api.md#finance--admin-only-encrypted-adr-0014.

**Story:** The admin turns on finance once. The server creates the encryption key and gives the admin a finance key and a recovery key to keep; it can't read either back later.

POST /finance/vault/setup — creates the vault in `pending` state.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only. No body.

- `201` `{ financeKey, recoveryKey }`, shown **once**. Losing both means the finance data can't be read.
- Next: Confirm Vault with the recovery key. Until then the vault can't be unlocked.
- Calling setup again before confirming replaces both keys.
- `409 FINANCE_ALREADY_INITIALIZED` once confirmed.
- The test script stores both keys in collection variables for the next requests.

- Every finance response sends `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- Salespeople get `403 FORBIDDEN`. See docs/api.md#finance--admin-only-encrypted-adr-0014.

**Story:** Right after setup, the admin types the recovery key back in to prove it was saved; that activates finance.

POST /finance/vault/confirm — activates a pending vault.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only.

- Body `recoveryKey` (string, required): `RK-` key from setup. Case, spaces, dashes and O/I/L look-alikes are ignored; the prefix is optional.
- `200` vault status with `confirmed: true`.
- `422 INVALID_FINANCE_KEY` wrong key (counts toward the lockout); `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` not key-shaped; `409 FINANCE_NOT_INITIALIZED` no vault; `409 FINANCE_ALREADY_INITIALIZED` already confirmed; `429 FINANCE_UNLOCK_BLOCKED`.

- Every finance response sends `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- Salespeople get `403 FORBIDDEN`. See docs/api.md#finance--admin-only-encrypted-adr-0014.

**Story:** The admin enters the finance key to open the finance screens; the app gets a session token to send with every finance request.

POST /finance/unlock — starts an unlock session.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only.

- Body `financeKey` (string, required): `FK-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`, forgiving input as for the recovery key.
- `200` `{ sessionToken, expiresAt }`. Send the token as `X-Finance-Session`. Keep it in memory (web) or Keychain/Keystore (mobile).
- The session locks after 30 minutes idle (each finance request extends it) and after 8 hours at most.
- `422 INVALID_FINANCE_KEY`; five wrong keys in 15 minutes → `429 FINANCE_UNLOCK_BLOCKED` for 15 minutes; `409 FINANCE_VAULT_NOT_CONFIRMED`; `409 FINANCE_NOT_INITIALIZED`.
- The test script stores the token as `financeSessionToken`.

- Every finance response sends `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- Salespeople get `403 FORBIDDEN`. See docs/api.md#finance--admin-only-encrypted-adr-0014.

response.name: 429 — FINANCE_UNLOCK_BLOCKED

request.description:
**Story:** The admin taps Lock (or signs out) and the finance screens close until the key is entered again.

POST /finance/lock — ends the session named by `X-Finance-Session`.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only. No body.

- Always `204`, even with no or an unknown token.
- Clears `financeSessionToken`.

- Every finance response sends `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- Salespeople get `403 FORBIDDEN`. See docs/api.md#finance--admin-only-encrypted-adr-0014.

**Story:** The admin replaces the finance key, for example after sharing it by mistake. Finance data stays as it is; only the key that unlocks it changes.

POST /finance/vault/change-key — issues a new finance key.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only, plus a live `X-Finance-Session`.

- Body `currentKey` (string, required): the finance key in use.
- `200` `{ financeKey }`, shown once. Every other session ends; this one stays unlocked. The recovery key is unchanged.
- `423 FINANCE_LOCKED` no valid session; `422 INVALID_FINANCE_KEY` wrong current key (counts toward the lockout); `429 FINANCE_UNLOCK_BLOCKED`.
- The test script stores the new key as `financeKey`.

- Every finance response sends `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- Salespeople get `403 FORBIDDEN`. See docs/api.md#finance--admin-only-encrypted-adr-0014.

response.name: 423 — FINANCE_LOCKED

request.description:
**Story:** The admin lost the finance key and uses the recovery key to get a new one. The used recovery key is replaced too.

POST /finance/vault/recover — issues a new finance key and a new recovery key.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only. No session needed.

- Body `recoveryKey` (string, required).
- `200` `{ financeKey, recoveryKey }`, both shown once. The old keys stop working and every session ends.
- `422 INVALID_FINANCE_KEY` (counts toward the lockout); `429 FINANCE_UNLOCK_BLOCKED`; `409 FINANCE_VAULT_NOT_CONFIRMED`; `409 FINANCE_NOT_INITIALIZED`.
- The test script stores both new keys.

- Every finance response sends `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- Salespeople get `403 FORBIDDEN`. See docs/api.md#finance--admin-only-encrypted-adr-0014.

**Story:** The admin opens a tag picker while recording money, or manages their labels in settings.

GET /finance/tags — every tag, sorted by name.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only.

- Query `includeArchived` (optional, `true`/`false`, default false): include archived tags (settings screen).
- `200` array of `{ id, name, color, archived, createdAt, updatedAt }`. The first unlock creates the defaults (Purchase, Mediator commission, Painting, Service, Rubbing polish, Insurance, Tyres, Travel, Food, Fuel, Other).
- The test script stores the first tag id as `financeTagId`.

- Needs `X-Finance-Session` from Finance › Vault › Unlock; without a live one → `423 FINANCE_LOCKED`.
- Admin only (`403` otherwise). See docs/api.md#finance--tags-and-entries.

response.name: 423 — FINANCE_LOCKED

request.description:
**Story:** The admin adds a label that fits how they track money, such as RTO transfer.

POST /finance/tags — creates a tag.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only.

- Body `name` (string, required): 1–40 characters, spaces tidied; unique ignoring case, including archived tags.
- Body `color` (string, optional): `#RRGGBB`, or null.
- `201` the tag. `409 FINANCE_TAG_NAME_TAKEN` duplicate name; `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` bad name or colour.
- The test script stores the id as `financeTagId`.

- Needs `X-Finance-Session` from Finance › Vault › Unlock; without a live one → `423 FINANCE_LOCKED`.
- Admin only (`403` otherwise). See docs/api.md#finance--tags-and-entries.

**Story:** The admin renames, recolours, archives or restores a label; entries keep their labels either way.

PATCH /finance/tags/:id — changes a tag.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only.

- Path `id` (uuid): the tag.
- Body (at least one): `name` (string, unique ignoring case), `color` (`#RRGGBB` or null to clear), `archived` (boolean: true archives, false restores).
- An archived tag leaves pickers and can't be added to entries; entries that already have it keep it.
- `200` the tag. `404 NOT_FOUND`; `409 FINANCE_TAG_NAME_TAKEN`.

- Needs `X-Finance-Session` from Finance › Vault › Unlock; without a live one → `423 FINANCE_LOCKED`.
- Admin only (`403` otherwise). See docs/api.md#finance--tags-and-entries.

query.description: YYYY-MM-DD; at most 366 days after from

request.description:
**Story:** The admin reviews money in and out for a month, a car, or a tag, with totals at the top.

GET /finance/entries — the ledger, filtered, sorted and paged after decryption.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only.

- `from`, `to` (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive): required, at most 366 days apart, unless `vehicleId` is set.
- `vehicleId` (uuid): one car's entries, any dates. `unlinked=true`: business entries only.
- `kind`: `income` | `expense`. `showroomId` (uuid).
- `tagId`: comma-separated tag ids (any of). `purpose`: comma-separated `purchase`, `cost`, `sale`, `other`, `general`.
- `minAmount`, `maxAmount`: rupees. `search`: party, note and tag names.
- `sort`: `date` (newest first, default), `-date`, `amount` (largest first), `-amount`. `limit` (1–100, default 20), `offset`.
- `200` `{ items, total, limit, offset, truncated, totals: { income, expense, net } }`; totals cover every match. `truncated` means over 5,000 rows matched.
- `422 DATE_RANGE_REQUIRED` / `DATE_RANGE_TOO_LONG` / `INVALID_DATE_RANGE`.

- Needs `X-Finance-Session` from Finance › Vault › Unlock; without a live one → `423 FINANCE_LOCKED`.
- Admin only (`403` otherwise). See docs/api.md#finance--tags-and-entries.

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: YYYY-MM-DD; at most 366 days after from

response.name: 422 — DATE_RANGE_REQUIRED

query.description: YYYY-MM-DD; at most 366 days after from

request.description:
**Story:** The admin records money paid or received, from the ledger or straight from a car's screen.

POST /finance/entries — records one entry.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only.

- `kind` (required): `income` (received) or `expense` (paid); fixed after creation.
- `amount` (number, required): rupees above zero, two decimals at most.
- `entryDate` (YYYY-MM-DD, required).
- `tagIds` (uuid[], optional, ≤ 10): existing, non-archived tags.
- `vehicleId` (uuid or null): link to a car; the entry takes the car's showroom.
- `purpose` (optional): car-linked expense `purchase` | `cost` (default); car-linked income `sale` (default) | `other`; no car → `general`.
- `party` (≤ 120), `note` (≤ 1000): optional.
- `showroomId` (uuid, optional): business entries only; defaults to your home showroom.
- `201` the entry. `404` unknown car; `422 FINANCE_TAG_NOT_FOUND`, `FINANCE_TAG_ARCHIVED`, `INVALID_ENTRY_PURPOSE`, `ENTRY_SHOWROOM_FOLLOWS_VEHICLE`, `SHOWROOM_REQUIRED`.
- The test script stores the id as `financeEntryId`.

- Needs `X-Finance-Session` from Finance › Vault › Unlock; without a live one → `423 FINANCE_LOCKED`.
- Admin only (`403` otherwise). See docs/api.md#finance--tags-and-entries.

request.description:
**Story:** The owner checks whether the business made money this month, and what drove it.

GET /finance/reports/pnl — profit & loss per period.

**Auth:** Bearer, Admin only.

- `from`, `to` (YYYY-MM-DD, required); `period` = day | week | month (default) | year; `showroomId` optional. day/week ≤ 366 days, month/year ≤ 5 years.
- Buckets (every period, even empty): `sales, costOfSales, grossProfit, laterCarCosts, otherIncome, businessExpenses, netProfit, carsSold, carsMissingPurchaseRate, uncountedSales`, plus `totals`.
- A sold car without a purchase rate has unknown profit: it counts in `carsSold` / `carsMissingPurchaseRate` but stays out of sales, cost of sales and profit (with its later costs); its price is in `uncountedSales`.
- A car counts on its sale date with its purchase rate and the costs up to that date; later costs, other income and business expenses count on their own dates. Payments to sellers / from buyers and unsold cars' costs are not in P&L.
- `422 DATE_RANGE_TOO_LONG` / `INVALID_DATE_RANGE`.

- Needs `X-Finance-Session`; without a live one → `423 FINANCE_LOCKED`. Admin only (`403` otherwise).
- Amounts are rupees; profits can be negative. `truncated: true` means over 5,000 entries were involved.
- See docs/api.md#finance--reports.
